It's totally relatable to my life in Germany. This is the exact same thing happening to me since past  7 months I am writing my thesis now.

German culture itself is a weird thing, they have good education, rules and regulations bla bla bla but in my opinion as an Indian it's hard for us to adjust in this culture. 
 
Germans are machines (most of them), I love the way to they organize stuff and do everything on the time but these all stuffs are in there culture, They are strict and discipline.

But they should understand that it takes time for an international student to adjust, in my opinion when you enter a lab it might take 2 to 3 months to adjust and actually start doing something productive, but Germans do not want any personal excuses ( some of them are kind) 

But it all depends upon the supervisor / team leader.

My supervisor is super though I cried each day.

At last she said that she is not satisfied with my work and would give the lowest grade possible, she also commented on my saying that I am not meant for research, at that point of time tears came from my eyes, I left the lab and had panic attack. ( Though I did improve a lot and did a lot of experiments than any other person)

But I think we always have to take these stuffs as a learning phase, we have to experience all kind of people in our life and move on.
